info.scriptSrcText: property pFunction, pScoreMem, pGameID, pTitle1, pScreenW, pScreenH, pMarker, pScoreDesglobal gMapID, gJustSubmitted, gSwScoreSetupList, gSwScoreNetIDon getPropertyDescriptionList me  return [#pFunction: [#comment: "Submit / View Button?", #format: #symbol, #range: [#submit, #view], #default: #submit], #pScoreMem: [#comment: "Field or text member holding score:", #format: #member, #default: EMPTY], #pGameID: [#comment: "Game ID:", #format: #string, #default: EMPTY], #pTitle1: [#comment: "Game Title:", #format: #string, #default: EMPTY], #pScreenW: [#comment: "Screen Width", #format: #integer, #default: (the stage).rect.width], #pScreenH: [#comment: "Screen Height", #format: #integer, #default: (the stage).rect.height], #pMarker: [#comment: "Marker to wait at while HS Hub downloads:", #format: #marker, #default: EMPTY], #pScoreDes: [#comment: "Score Descriptor (points, kills, etc.)", #format: #string, #default: "points"]]endon getBehaviorDescription  return "DESCRIPTION:" & RETURN & "This is the only behavior required for high score setup. It will configure your movie for Name, Score scores display." & RETURN & "Additional optional behaviors are required if you want to use more fields or have multiple players." & RETURN & RETURN & "PARAMETERS:" & RETURN & "\xA5 Submit Scores Button / View Scores Button: Which button is this behavior on?" & RETURN & "\xA5 Text member holding Score: The text member holding the score." & RETURN & "\xA5 Game ID: Unique ID provided to you by Macromedia." & RETURN & "\xA5 Game Title: Title to display in the HS Hub." & RETURN & "\xA5 Screen Width: Width of your game's screen." & RETURN & "\xA5 Screen Height: Height of your game's screen." & RETURN & "\xA5 Marker to wait at while HS Hub downloads: set up this marker in your game." & RETURN & "\xA5 Score descriptor: How would you like your score labeled?" & RETURN & RETURN & "-- \xA9 kwik 2000"endon mouseDown me  initList(me)endon mouseUp me  branchToScores(me)endon initList me  if not listp(gSwScoreSetupList) then    gSwScoreSetupList = [:]    sort(gSwScoreSetupList)  end if  addToList(me, #gameid, pGameID)  addToList(me, #gametitle1, pTitle1)  addToList(me, #gametitle2, EMPTY)  addToList(me, #width, pScreenW)  addToList(me, #height, pScreenH)  addToList(me, #userName, EMPTY)  addToList(me, #userscore, pScoreMem.text)  addToList(me, #scoredesc, pScoreDes)  addToList(me, #movielocation, the moviePath & the movieName)  addToList(me, #optional1, [])  addToList(me, #optional2, [])  addToList(me, #optional3, [])  addToList(me, #function, pFunction)  addToList(me, #status, #START)endon addToList me, whatProp, whatValue  if voidp(getaProp(gSwScoreSetupList, whatProp)) then    addProp(gSwScoreSetupList, whatProp, whatValue)  else    setaProp(gSwScoreSetupList, whatProp, whatValue)  end ifendon branchToScores me  case (the environment).runMode of    "Plugin":      if (the environment).shockMachine = 1 then        myURL = setupGlobalBranch(me)      else        if the moviePath contains "http://" then          myURL = setupGlobalBranch(me)        else          myURL = EMPTY        end if      end if      gSwScoreNetID = [gotoNetMovie(myURL), myURL]    "Author":      repeat with n = 1 to count(the windowList)        if (the windowList)[n].name contains "scorez-2000" then          forget(window(n))        end if      end repeat      open(window("http://www.shockwave.com/content/highscores/nosave/hshub-2000-2.dcr"))    "Projector":  end case  go(pMarker)endon setupGlobalBranch me  if not voidp(externalParamValue("swURL")) then    myURL = externalParamValue("swURL")  else    myGameURL = the moviePath    the itemDelimiter = "/"    mySite = item 3 of myGameURL    if (myGameURL contains "http://") and (mySite contains "shockwave.com") then      the itemDelimiter = "."      myPrefix = item 1 of mySite      myURL = "http://" & myPrefix & ".shockwave.com/content/highscores/scorez-2000.dcr"    else      myURL = "http://www.shockwave.com/content/highscores/scorez-2000.dcr"    end if  end if  return myURLend
info.name: High Score Hub - Standard.
